description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.
name: Use of Hard-coded Password

description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.
name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.
name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource

description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

evidence.explanation: CatalogService.UpdateCatalogItem (73-76), RemoveCatalogItem (79-82), and CreateAvailableStock (99-116) modify catalog pricing/inventory and commit changes without recording actor, target, before/after values, outcome, or an audit event. No application logging/audit calls, EF audit override or WCF message audit configuration was found in scoped source/configuration. These business-sensitive mutations therefore have no source-level application audit trail; external IIS/database auditing is deployment-dependent and was not assessed.

name: Insufficient Logging

description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
